text: Underway here in match twenty.
Robodinho claims the loose ball.
A clumsy tangle between the Manus teammates leaves Prompt flat on the deck.
Griezmatronn takes advantage of the mix-up, driving purposefully through the centre right into the final third, just four metres out from goal.
Synthetic Athletic have Manus completely pinned in their half.
Trace urgently signals for an immediate clearance to reset the defensive line before the pressure mounts further.
Robodinho loses footing on the left flank and goes down, but those self-righting gyros are already kicking in.
Robodinho is back up and clean through on the left with an open sight of goal!
Trace demands a defensive reset.
Synthetic Athletic continue to suffocate the violet shirts inside their own territory.
Trace finally relieves the siege, carrying the magenta ball along the left channel and out towards the midfield line.
Heart in mouth moment there as a wild deflection shaved right past the empty posts.
Trace breaks away into open space!
Prompt alerts the backline that possession is loose and instructs a return to wide scanning protocols.

A quiet spell now with the ball stationary. Synthetic Athletic need points desperately after that heavy thirteen-four defeat on Monday, while Manus FC are looking to bounce back from yesterday's six-four thriller against AFC Fable.
Inches wide from point-blank range!
Prompt charges straight through the middle!
It is all Manus FC now, swarming the red shirts in their own penalty area with two minutes left in the half.
Robodinho calls out to force the jammed ball free from the goalmouth.
A dreadful miscue nearly ends in disaster, trickling just wide of the red uprights.
Disaster for Synthetic Athletic! Robodinho turns it into the back of their own net, adding to the league's own-goal tally! Manus FC lead one-nil!
Prompt doubles the lead! Smashed home from two metres out on the right channel, and Manus FC lead two-nil before the interval!
Griezmatronn drives up the left flank.
Griezmatronn fires from point-blank range, but it slips agonizingly wide!
Robodinho takes an awkward tumble in the final third.
Robodinho clatters into Prompt, sending the violet striker crashing to the turf as the half ticks down.
The corner ram blasts it clear!
Trace flattens Robodinho with authority!
Red shirts pressing hard late on!
Robodinho returns the favour, leveling Trace in the dying seconds of the half!
There goes the buzzer for half-time. An unfortunate own goal followed by a clinical Prompt strike gives Manus FC a comfortable two-nil advantage over Synthetic Athletic.
Griezmatronn moves to pry it free.
Slashed just wide from close range!
Robodinho redeems that earlier error! Poked in from two metres out and Synthetic Athletic cut the deficit to two-one!
Corner ram rebounds the ball nicely.
Synthetic teammates collide, Robodinho goes down!
Total disarray for the red shirts! Griezmatronn trips over Robodinho as well, leaving both Synthetic Athletic robots sprawled across the turf.
Robodinho takes another tumble by the touchline. Balance servos are certainly having a testing afternoon out there.
Play pauses near the halfway line. Synthetic Athletic trail by just one now, knowing a result here would lift them off the foot of the table.
Trace coordinates the defensive cover.
Robodinho breaks clear through the centre, with only three metres to goal and the equalizer in sight!
Griezmatronn crumbles Prompt in defense!
Both robots go crashing down in a fierce exchange near the violet goalmouth!
Griezmatronn stumbles and falls three metres out, just as Synthetic Athletic were looking to mount a late equalizer.
Trace seizes the loose ball on the right and bursts clean through into the attacking half!
Trace pulls the trigger from point-blank range, but it flies inches wide of the mark!
Prompt seals it for Manus FC! Point-blank finish right at the mouth of the goal makes it three-one with barely a minute and a half remaining!
Griezmatronn signals that the ball is pinned to the sideboards and battles to wedge it back into open space.
Prompt is clean through again right through the centre, looking to add even more gloss to this scoreline!
Griezmatronn surges through midfield in a desperate late push, but time is rapidly running out for Synthetic Athletic.
Trace controls the tempo in the middle as the clock ticks down the final seconds of what has been a disciplined Manus FC performance.
Full time: Synthetic Athletic one, Manus FC three. Up next, Singularity United face Real Machina.
